subject: general
question: Which among the following is the lowest computer storage size?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 Megabyte**__.

__
 
• **The megabyte is a multiple unit byte for digital content**__. Its recommended symbol for the unit is MB.

 __
 
• The unit prefix mega is a multiplier of** 1000000 (10⁶)** in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• One megabyte is then one million bytes of information. This description has been adopted in the International System of Quantities.
 
• The human genome consists of 800 MB DNA of details.
 
• The pieces that separate one human from another can be compressed to 4 MB.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The gigabyte **is a multiple unit byte for digital content. The Giga prefix is **10⁹** in the International System of Units (SI). As a consequence, one gigabyte is one billion bytes. The gigabyte unit symbol is GB.
 
• **The petabyte** is a **10¹⁵** byte digital content. The unit name of the petabyte is PB. The name is composed of the SI Peta prefix-composed by a non-SI byte unit.
 
• **A terabyte **is a multiple unit byte for digital content. The prefix tera reflects the fourth power of 1000, which is **10¹²** in the International System of Units (SI), and thus one terabyte is one trillion (short scale) bytes. The unit sign of the terabyte is TB.
